# `oaap machine`

machine principals (RFC-0027) -- accounts that authenticate by key, never by password.

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap machine [--roles ROLES] [--groups GROUPS] [--tenant TENANT]
                    [--title TITLE]
                    {add,list} [name]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `name` | -- |
| `--roles ROLES` | comma-separated, default 'user'; server_admin refused |
| `--groups GROUPS` | comma-separated visibility groups (RFC-0007) |
| `--tenant TENANT` | tenant label or id; default is this node's default tenant |
| `--title TITLE` | display name |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `add` | yes |
| `list` | yes |
